source_read: https://api-production.mbplc.io/webappbff/api/v1/menus/dynamic/?id=1001316&websitePageUrlPath=main-menu1&idType=TradingEntity&salesChannel=DynamicWebMenus (live M&B menu feed, downloaded afresh 2026-10-08 19:0x UTC, lastModified 2026-10-08T19:03:15; the API host has no robots.txt (404), the sizzlingpubs.co.uk pages are behind a Cloudflare challenge and were not touched)
not_verifiable: The rendered venue menu page cannot be opened (Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge, not worked round), so no page-level visual comparison; the feed JSON is the source and was parsed independently (own code walking sections/subSections, own allergen-key mapping).
notes: DRIFT: the live feed changed since data/source (6 Oct): 19 dishes have slightly different numbers (e.g. Chick'n Mix 1146 to 1129 kcal, Salt and Chilli Chicken Fries 377 to 359, Crispy Sweet Chilli Chicken 943 to 908) and 'Cappuccino' is now spelt 'Cappucino'; script re-run on the fresh feed (rename keeps id cappuccino) and data/source/sizzling-pubs rebuilt, checked_on 2026-10-08. All 104 rebuilt rows match the fresh feed on all 7 nutrients and on contains/may-contain/cereals (own mapping, tree-nut/cereal policy honoured); Scampi and Chips stays held back (826 kcal printed vs about 672 from its own macros). The feed has no ingredient text, so allergens could be checked only against dish names/descriptions and claims: 2 low name-implies-sulphites flags (red wine lasagne, port sauce) kept as the chain prints them (judgement call).
